summary.title: Agentic Infrastructure - Vercel
summary.one_liner: Vercel's marketing page describing its platform for running apps and agents, with feature names like durable orchestration, sandboxed environments, and an AI model gateway.
keywords: how to host apps that scale from zero
takeaways: Vercel positions its platform as infrastructure for coding agents to ship apps and agents.
The page lists four feature areas for agents: durable orchestration, sandboxed environments, AI model gateway, and fluid compute.
For scaling apps, it lists global delivery, deployment environments, serverless functions, and a web application firewall.
For host platforms, it lists tenant isolation, domain management, custom SSL certificates, and preview URLs.
The page cites customers Notion, Zapier, and Mintlify, but gives few technical details about how the features work.
summary.summary: This is Vercel's product landing page, titled "Agentic Infrastructure", pitching its platform for coding agents and for apps that scale. It is organized into three use-case sections (agents, scaling apps, and multi-tenant host platforms), each with a short feature list and a customer claim. The page is mostly marketing and names features without explaining implementation, pricing, or APIs, so it is best treated as an overview rather than a tutorial.
